KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

2. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. zito
   C. nene
   D. pana

3. When practising huyu na hawa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to huyu na hawa.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.
   C. Use insults to “practise” huyu na hawa.
   D. Copy random text without understanding huyu na hawa.

4. When practising asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   C. Copy random text without understanding asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   D. Avoid reading anything related to asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

5. When practising Kuzungumza:Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

6. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

7. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mato
   B. watoto
   C. mitoto
   D. kitoto

8. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

9. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain wakati uliopo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain majina and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
